items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: John had the guitar, Martin had the bass, and Mary would play the piano... Mary’s playing the background on the piano.

ctx.x: Well we used to have fish dinners on Christmas eve. That was a big thing. My sister used to make twelve different fish.

But the next day after dinner, we would all sit in the living room and we had the piano there, John had the guitar, Martin had the bass, and Mary would play the piano, and John is telling a story and Mary’s playing the background on the piano.
Yeah, oh wow. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
